notes: AI performance metrics consolidate local signed reports, benchmark history, capability spot evidence, and fit estimates.
This report does not execute benchmarks automatically and does not start an external runtime.
Fit estimates are never treated as measured benchmark proof.
Local evidence does not imply backend approval, remote Proof of Capability, scheduler admission, or marketplace eligibility.

notes: Capability spot verification is a local/mock signal derived from fit analysis, runtime state, signed evidence, and optional live benchmark proof.
It does not create workload eligibility, marketplace admission, backend approval, or a scheduling guarantee.
A current signed report with a passing llm benchmark is stronger evidence than fit-only capability inference.
capability_spot.summary: fit evidence supports local AI capability; live benchmark evidence is current; capability score 85.0; verification status self_verified.
warnings: challenge-backed capability evidence is not available yet

notes: Local network score is derived from the latest finite network benchmark only.
Network score weights: 45% latency, 20% jitter, 25% loss/success, 10% DNS resolution.
Network score is not backend availability, public reachability, marketplace admission, or a payout guarantee.

warnings: Prices are demonstrative and depend on future Burd marketplace policy.

notes: Local reliability is derived from local heartbeat history only.
Reliability score weights: 70% uptime score, 15% sample coverage, 15% latest status, minus consecutive failure penalty.
Reliability score is not backend availability, audit approval, marketplace admission, or a payout guarantee.
warnings: fewer than 3 heartbeat checks; reliability score is warming up

notes: Workload eligibility is a local decision layer built on top of fit analysis, capability spot verification, trust score, and marketplace GPU policy.
Local eligibility does not create a backend lease, a scheduler assignment, or a paid marketplace admission.
Future marketplace eligibility remains stricter than local eligibility and is blocked when marketplace policy or evidence quality is insufficient.
